label: Enable remote access
help: Off by default. While off, no request reaches Google and the wallet is never read.

label: OAuth grant secret
help: Wallet reference holding an access token, or JSON with client_id, client_secret and refresh_token. Never the token itself.

label: Calendar ID
help: Calendar read by default, changed by create, update and delete, and watched. primary is the account's main calendar; otherwise the ID from the calendar settings.

label: Default operation
help: Used when a request gives no operation. create_event and update_event need Allow changes; delete_event needs Allow deletion.

label: Operations a request may choose
help: JSON array among ["list_calendars", "list_events", "get_event", "free_busy", "watch", "create_event", "update_event", "delete_event"]. The default operation is always allowed.

label: Default time zone
help: IANA time zone for request times without an offset and for date-only windows. Empty: such times must carry an offset or a request time_zone.

label: Expand recurring events
help: On: list_events returns each occurrence of a recurring event. Off: one item per series. A request may choose with single_events.

label: Items per listing (max)
help: Upper bound for one list_events or list_calendars; a request limit can only lower it.

label: Allow changes
help: Off by default. Required for create_event and update_event.

label: Allow deletion
help: Off by default. Required for delete_event. A deleted event is cancelled for every guest.

label: Guest notifications
help: Emails Google sends to guests for a change. none by default; a request can only choose fewer notifications.

label: Let a request choose the calendar of a change
help: Off: changes always go to Calendar ID. On: a request may give another calendar_id the account can edit.

label: Watch the calendar in Active Runtime
help: Polls Calendar ID while a Run is active and publishes created, updated and cancelled events on changed. One Shot polls only on a watch request.

label: Poll interval (s)
help: Time between two polls, at least 60 seconds. Requested polls of this node also respect the 60-second minimum.

label: Changes per poll (max)
help: Changes published by one poll; the others wait for the next poll in order.

label: Report upcoming events at the first poll
help: Off: the first poll only records the current position. On: it also reports up to 100 upcoming events once, as existing.

label: Items per page
help: Items requested per Google page (calendar lists use at most 250). A page is never cut, so next_page_token resumes exactly.

label: Pages per request (max)
help: Google pages read by one listing or one poll; a listing then returns next_page_token, a poll resumes at the next poll.

label: Operation deadline (s)
help: Total time for one request or one poll, token exchange, pages and retries included.

label: Retries
help: Reads retry after HTTP 429, a rate-limit 403, 5xx or a lost connection; changes only after a rate limit.

label: Longest retry wait (s)
help: A Retry-After above this value returns rate_limited instead of waiting.

label: Request size limit (bytes)
help: Bound for the incoming request and for each JSON body sent to Google.

label: Response size limit (bytes)
help: Larger JSON responses from Google are refused as protocol errors.

label: Calendar API origin
help: Keep https://www.googleapis.com. Another origin receives the access token; plain HTTP only for a loopback test host.

label: OAuth token origin
help: Keep https://oauth2.googleapis.com. Used only with a refresh-token grant; plain HTTP only for a loopback test host.

label: Custom CA file
help: Optional absolute PEM file for a privately signed HTTPS origin. TLS verification cannot be disabled.
